newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Izhorskiye Zavody to issue shares.
newsitem.headline: Russian Izhorskiye Zavody to issue shares.

text.p: Russia's AO Izhorskiye Zavody plans to issue 100 billion roubles worth of ordinary shares in 1997, a company official said on Monday.
Securities department head Valentina Anisimova told Reuters current shareholders would not have priority rights to buy new stock.

"The shares will be placed at market value, but only when its market value will be close to or exceed the face value," Anisimova said. "Currently the market value of ordinary shares is much lower than the face value of 400,000 roubles ($70), that's why shares will not be placed in the near future. We shall wait for the market value to rise."
On the Russian Trading System, the local version of NASDAQ, Izhorskiye Zavody was traded at $39.30, when it was last traded on April 18.
The new issue raises the company's authorised capital to 664.4 billion from 564.4 billion roubles.
